description: WCAG 2 contrast ratio between a text colour and a background colour, with pass/fail for AA and AAA at normal and large text sizes. Use to check that a design is readable. Example: fg=#767676, bg=#ffffff. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: color_contrast
title: Color contrast check (WCAG)
